milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the birch plank structure (centered at spawn-relative [10, 1, 10]) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. The target is the center of the birch plank hut. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle boat results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so this cannot be pre-satisfied. The player must retrieve 5 jungle planks from the chest inside the birch hut, use the adjacent crafting table, arrange planks in a U-shape, and collect the resulting jungle_boat.
